Gauhati High Court

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Date : --30.05.2025 [M. Choudhury, J] Heard Mr. A. Sahad, learned counsel for the appellant and Ms. A. Begum, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent no. 1, State of Assam.

2. This criminal appeal under Section 415[2], Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita [BNSS], 2023 is preferred against a Judgment and Order dated 26.03.2025 passed by the Court of learned Special Judge [POCSO] Dhemaji in Special [POSCO] Case no. 18/2024, arising out of Gogamukh Police Station Case no 17/2024.

By the Judgment and Order dated 26.03.2025, the learned Special Court has convicted the appellant for the offences under Section 376 [1] and Section 506 of the Indian Penal Code [IPC] as well as under Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences [POCSO] Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences [POCSO] Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
In view of Section 42, POCSO Act, the appellant has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 20 [twenty] years and to pay a fine of Rs. 30,000/-, in default of payment of fine, to undergo rigorous imprisonment for another 2 [two] years under Section 4,
POCSO Act.

For the offence under Section 506, IPC, the appellant has been sentence to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 3 [three] years, and to pay a fine of Rs. 5,000/-, in default of payment of fine, to undergo rigorous imprisonment for another 3 [three] months.
The sentences are ordered to run concurrently.
3. We have gone through the contents of the memorandum of appeal.
4. The criminal appeal is admitted for hearing.
5. The case records of Special [POSCO] Case no. 18/2024 be called for.
6. Issue notice, returnable in 4 [four] weeks.
Page No.# 3/3 7.

As Ms. Begum, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 1, State of Assam, issuance of formal notice in respect of the said respondent stands dispensed with.

The learned counsel for the appellant shall, however, be furnished an extra copy of the memo of appeal along with annexures, to Ms. Begum within 3 [three]
working days from today.

8. The appellant shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no. 2, in terms of the Practice Direction laid down in the Notification no. 17 dated 15.03.2024.
9.

The learned Additional Public Prosecutor shall obtain a report from the Officer In- Charge of the Gogamukh Police Station as regards the service of notice upon the respondent no. 2 and place the same before this Court on or before the returnable date.
10. List the appeal after 4 [four] weeks.
